scope: Nepali paper counting hierarchy and its relation to the unresolved 1843 Hodgson/Wallich paper bill.
central_claim: Independent Nepali lexical and paper-industry evidence strongly validates tau -> dhep -> kori as a paper-count hierarchy: one tau is one paper sheet/folio, ten tau make one dhep, twenty dhep make one kori, hence one kori is two hundred tau. Cambridge's 1843 catalogue transcription ḍhyāp with a ten-sheet gloss is therefore a very strong candidate for the Nepali unit ढेप/ḍhep(a), although the original bill remains unread and exact orthography/romanization is unresolved.

evidence: Nepali-English lexical sources: tau = sheet of paper
Bhupahari Paudel 1987 paper-industry hierarchy uses tau as the sheet-level count
Nepali lexical definition: ढेप = ten tau of Nepali paper in one stack/bundle
Nepali-English definition: dhepa = bundle/quire of Nepalese paper consisting of 10 sheets
Nepali lexical definition: kori = group of twenty dhep of paper
Bhupahari Paudel 1987: 20 dhep = 1 kori and 1 kori = 200 tau
modern handmade-paper production literature continues to use 1 kori = 200 sheets/tau

hodgson_1843_bill.catalogue_rates: Rupees 10/- and 14/- per bundle as prose-transcribed

evidence_hierarchy.source: Bhupahari Paudel, Ancient Nepal no.103, 1987-1988, p.33
evidence_hierarchy.evidence_type: directly inspected printed description of traditional Nepali paper factory/practice
evidence_hierarchy.limitation: late twentieth-century documentation, not 1843 primary evidence
does not by itself date usage to 1843

comparative_non_equivalent_units.control: English quire historically 24/25 sheets in Moxon context; not equivalent to Nepali dhep despite dictionary use of English word quire

source_control_rules: Preserve Cambridge ḍhyāp transcription and normalized candidate ढेप/ḍhep(a) as separate fields.
Do not state that the original 1843 bill spells ढेप until the page is directly inspected.
Treat ten sheets per dhep as independently validated but the f.117 total quantity and rate structure as unresolved.
Do not equate dictionary English gloss quire with English trade quire.
Do not back-calculate the 1843 bill using late twentieth-century or modern kori prices.
Keep Nepal tau/dhep/kori, Kashmir dasta, North Indian dasta/takhta and English quire/ream systems non-equivalent.
next_actions: Recover f.117 recto and read original term, quantity columns and price-unit headings
Check whether kori occurs on f.117 as aggregate or price unit
Recover 1827 Wallich bills for recurrence of tau/dhep/kori
Search pre-1900 Nepali legal/account records and dictionaries for dhep/kori paper usage
Search Hodgson archive for romanized dhep/dhyap, ten sheets, twenty bundles and 200 sheets
Add tau/dhep/kori hierarchy fields to the paper census protocol
